title: Fahrerflucht nach Fahrzeugkontrolle auf der A 100

extraction.placeName: Stadtautobahn A 100, between Oberlandstraße and Tempelhofer Damm
extraction.summaryEn: A driver fled a vehicle check on the A 100 motorway, dragging a police officer about ten metres and injuring his hand. The car was later found abandoned and seized on Sachsendamm.
